method: Godot reviewed rectangular transparent crop; get_used_rect; INTERPOLATE_NEAREST aspect fit into 120x152; blit into 128x160 transparent RGBA8. No alpha or color editing.
crop_note: Built-in source has sub-8/255 alpha remnants in outer gutters and the nominal empty cell. Crop rectangles retain every pixel with alpha>=8 in each character cell plus padding. Low-alpha pixels inside crop rectangles are preserved verbatim. Outer empty gutters and sixth cell are discarded; final preview sixth cell is newly allocated alpha=0.
source_dimensions_note: Requested 1536x1280; actual original 1374x1145. Output PNGs are technical reductions, not native 128x160 generations.
